site.name: Word Fit
site.pitch: A crossword with the answers already given. All you have to do is make them fit.
site.description: Word Fit is a free fill-in crossword: every word is listed, and you drag each one into the grid where it fits. Four difficulties, a daily puzzle, Time Attack, and puzzles in English, Afrikaans and Symbols. For iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows and Linux.

hero: No clues to crack. Every word is in the list: read the grid, count the letters, and drag each word to the one place it fits. Crossings lock it all together.

how.title: Pick up a word
how.text: Press a word in the list. It lifts off and follows your finger, sitting just above it so you can see where it lands.

how.title: Drop it in a slot
how.text: Let go over a row or column of the same length. Tap a word, then a square, if you'd rather not drag.

how.title: Fit every word
how.text: Where words cross they must share a letter. Fill the grid and the puzzle is solved: faster, with fewer mistakes, earns more stars.

languages.name: English
languages.text: Over 16,000 everyday words, from the films and series people actually watch: common ones on Easy, rarer ones on Expert.

languages.name: Afrikaans
languages.text: Ten thousand Afrikaans words, with the interface in Afrikaans too: Maklik to Kenner. Rare in word games, and a proper workout.

languages.name: Symbols
languages.text: English words with every letter drawn as a picture, and a new code for every puzzle. You can't read them, so you match their shapes.

builds.detail: iOS 15 and later. Bigger grids on iPad.
Phones and tablets, Android 7 and later

steps: Download the ZIP and open it: you get Word Fit.app.
Drag it into your Applications folder.
Open it. It's signed and notarised by Apple, so it opens like any other app.

builds.note: Windows may say it protected your PC, as the game isn't signed for Windows: choose More info, then Run anyway.
steps: Download the ZIP, right-click it and choose Extract All. Running it from inside the ZIP won't work.
Open the Word Fit folder and run Word Fit.exe.
Keep the .exe and the files beside it together.
Download the ZIP and extract it.
Make the game runnable if it isn't: chmod +x WordFit.x86_64.
Run it from the folder it's in.

faq: How do I take a word back out?
Drag it off the grid, or tap it twice. It goes back to the list.
You earn coins for every puzzle you solve (more for more stars, and a bonus for the daily puzzle). Spend them on hints, or on themes in the Shop: new backgrounds, tiles and music.
The bulb in the corner has two. Check sends every wrong word back to the list; Place a word puts one word where it belongs and locks it in.
Is the daily puzzle the same for everyone?
Yes: one Medium puzzle a day, the same on every phone, tablet and computer. Solve it on consecutive days to build a streak.
They're English words, with each letter drawn as a picture. Every puzzle has its own code, so a cat isn't always an A: count the pictures, look for repeats, and match the shapes where words cross.
On your device, in the game's own storage. There are no accounts, so it isn't kept anywhere else: uninstalling the game removes it.
Can I play on a computer?
Yes: there are builds for Mac, Windows and Linux on the Download page, with the bigger grids iPads get.
